No one counts the MoUs

The denominator problem.
DECISION
Four explanations, read as layers
SPONSORThe developer lacks capital, experience or partners.Screen sponsors; limit exclusivity; attach milestones and securities.
PROCESSHow the project was originated.Compete by default; test unsolicited proposals against the plan.
SYSTEMThe plan, the grid and the buyer.Fix the system before adding contracts.
FISCALThe state's capacity to support.Apply the sovereign test; size support to fiscal space.
Not rivals. Layers. Which one binds first?
